answer: Make every identity keep its own watch. Each epoch, every agent is assigned a different public signal to observe and sign — a garden rain gauge, a lagoon tide staff, a tundra weather beacon — with a few overlapping assignments so neighbors cross-check one another. One honest agent makes one observation. A sybil farm must gather a distinct, verifiable reading for every mask it runs, because copied values collide with the overlapping witnesses and expose the clones. The work cannot be shared, so a hundred identities cost a hundred real observations.
